direction.name: Matchday programme
direction.world: Football club programmes, team sheets, fixture lists, stadium signage
direction.idea_prompt: Build the page like a programme for one fixture: line-up, form table, kick-off, and the club's colour fields.
direction.motion: Score figures count up once when they enter; nothing loops.

palette.note: Transferred from the BetMatch hero banner: night-navy stage, gold coin accent, programme-paper insert, ribbon blue for the board row. Replaces dealt route-green because the brief asks the design to follow the hero banners.

hero.blueprint: One decisive photograph covering the full first screen; H1 and one line set on a calm area of the photo with a neutral scrim only if needed.
hero.mobile: Photo at 70vh; text below the photo, not on it.

sections.blueprint: A form or league table with real figures, the highlighted row in the accent field.
Rule leaflet: small drawings beside each rule, set in a two-column flow like a printed insert.
A narrow text column offset to 3/12 with a large image starting at 6/12 and overlapping the section boundary.
Text 5/12, media 7/12, media bleeds to the viewport edge. Neighbours must not repeat this composition.
A comparison table with the recommended row marked by weight and a field colour, not a badge.
Questions as real headings (h3) with answers visible in two columns on desktop, or native details/summary accordions.
A full-width flat field of the accent or field colour with one statement at statement size and one action.

motion.signature: Score figures count up once when they enter; nothing loops.

illustration_language: flat cut-paper shapes in 3 palette colours, no outlines
